nodes.question: What did Xu et al. study regarding the coordinated development of the coupled system?
nodes.answer: Xu et al. studied Jiangsu Province and found that environmental factors were the main factors affecting the coordinated development of the coupled system.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why is a co-ordinated approach among different hierarchical levels of governance crucial for pursuing the energy transition?
nodes.answer: A co-ordinated approach among different hierarchical levels of governance is crucial for pursuing the energy transition as without it, local economies and communities tied up to fossil-fuel-based businesses would face immediate and acute uncertainties.
